name: bang
title: Bang
description: Search local Bash, Zsh and Fish history, then review and run commands in a terminal
author: professormahi

commands.name: bang
commands.title: Bang
commands.description: Fuzzy-search shell history, edit or run a command, and optionally set up the ! alias

preferences.name: reviewBeforeRun
preferences.title: Command Review
preferences.label: Open the editor before running a command
preferences.description: Disable to make Run in Terminal the primary action. The confirmation dialog is configured separately; editing remains available.

preferences.name: confirmBeforeRun
preferences.title: Execution Confirmation
preferences.label: Confirm before running a command
preferences.description: Disable to skip the final Run confirmation. If editor review is also disabled, pressing Run/Enter launches immediately with your full user privileges. Terminal-close approval and sensitive-copy confirmation are separate.

preferences.name: saveHistory
preferences.title: Save Executed Commands
preferences.label: Add executed commands to the configured shell history
preferences.description: Save new and repeated commands after the shell exits, including failed commands. This writes full command text (possibly secrets) to History Path. Disable for private commands.

preferences.name: shell
preferences.title: Shell
preferences.description: History format and execution shell. Auto uses SHELL, falling back to Bash.

preferences.name: historyPath
preferences.title: History Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute history path or ~/path. No shell expansion is performed.

preferences.name: shellPath
preferences.title: Shell Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute executable path for the selected shell. Otherwise uses SHELL for auto or /bin/bash, /bin/zsh, /usr/bin/fish.

preferences.name: maxItems
preferences.title: Maximum History Items
preferences.description: Unique commands retained from the bounded history snapshot (1–50000).

preferences.name: workingDirectory
preferences.title: Working Directory
preferences.description: Absolute directory or ~/path used for execution; defaults to your home directory.

preferences.name: hold
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.label: Wait for Enter before closing the terminal
preferences.description: The runner waits for your approval after the command exits, even for fast or failed commands. Does not depend on terminal-emulator hold support.
